headline: Monday free hub stories · Food Festival this weekend
summary: Today: free story/craft and baby rhyme at Cardiff Hubs. Looking ahead: free St Fagans Food Festival Sat–Sun 12–13 Sep, Brick Festival Sat, Techniquest Toddler Day Fri (TQ closed Mon–Thu for maintenance).

notices.title: Techniquest closed Mon–Thu this week
notices.detail: Closed for maintenance Mon 7–Thu 10 Sep. Reopens Fri 11 Sep for Toddler Day (09:00–16:00), then Sat–Sun normal hours. Relaxed Session Sun 13 Sep 10:00–12:00.

notices.title: National Museum Cardiff — closed Mondays
notices.detail: Closed today (Mon). Open Tue–Sun 10:00–17:00. Free entry; book a free day ticket if you can.

notices.title: Museum of Cardiff — still closed
notices.detail: Museum of Cardiff (Old Library / The Hayes) remains closed due to a leak; organisers will update when they know more.

notices.title: Weather — Met Office Cardiff
notices.detail: Mon: sunny intervals ~20°C, rain returning evening. Tue: heavy rain early then brighter/showery. Wed: drier and brighter. Good day for indoor hub sessions this morning.

datedPicks.title: Story Time and Craft
datedPicks.location: Llandaff North and Gabalfa Hub, College Road, Llandaff North CF14 2HU
datedPicks.description: Share a story with your child and make a craft tied to the tale. Weekly Mondays and Thursdays 10:30–11:30 at Llandaff North and Gabalfa Hub.
datedPicks.whyPicked: Free local hub session with clear age fit, craft included, and a north Cardiff venue — distinctive over tourist defaults on a Monday morning.
datedPicks.parentHeadsUp: Also runs Thursday 10:30–11:30. Drop-in style library hub session — arrive a few minutes early.

datedPicks.title: Baby Rhyme Time
datedPicks.location: Penylan Library and Community Centre, Penylan Road, Penylan CF23 5HW
datedPicks.description: Song and movement session for babies who are not yet walking. Every Monday 11:00–11:30 at Penylan Library.
datedPicks.whyPicked: Clear 0–4 (pre-walkers) free weekly slot — fills the under-five band the morning shortlist often misses.
datedPicks.parentHeadsUp: Organiser: for babies not yet walking. Contact Penylan Library 02920 788413 if unsure.

datedPicks.title: Story and Rhyme Time
datedPicks.location: Canton Library, Library Street, Canton CF5 1QD
datedPicks.description: Popular weekly story and rhyme session. Mondays in English, Fridays in Welsh. Borrow books while you’re there.
datedPicks.whyPicked: Free afternoon English session in Canton — useful same-day option if morning slots clash.
datedPicks.parentHeadsUp: Welsh-language session is Fridays at the same venue pattern — check the Hub page.

datedPicks.title: Story Time and Craft
datedPicks.location: Llandaff North and Gabalfa Hub, College Road, Llandaff North CF14 2HU
datedPicks.description: Same free story-and-craft session as Monday — also every Thursday 10:30–11:30.
datedPicks.whyPicked: Second free weekday slot this week at the same north Cardiff hub — handy if Monday is missed.

datedPicks.title: Techniquest Toddler Day
datedPicks.location: Techniquest, Stuart Street, Cardiff Bay CF10 5BW
datedPicks.cost: Under-3s free · adult from £15.45 · book ahead
datedPicks.description: Pre-schoolers get exclusive run of the exhibits plus Toddler Day extras (transfers, colouring, book nook). Sep extras: Star Stories Oi Frog! (£2 add-on) and Mini Wildlings by Flossy and Boo (included, book ahead).
datedPicks.whyPicked: Single tourist backup this week — dated Toddler Day with named extras after a four-day maintenance closure.
datedPicks.parentHeadsUp: TQ closed Mon–Thu; Fri is Toddler Day only until 16:00. Book tickets and Mini Wildlings spaces ahead.
datedPicks.bookingStatus: paid · book ahead on Techniquest tickets

datedPicks.title: St Fagans Food Festival
datedPicks.location: St Fagans National Museum of History, Cardiff CF5 6XB
datedPicks.cost: Free entry · parking £7 · some activities paid
datedPicks.description: Annual free festival with 80+ food, drink and craft stalls among the historic buildings, cookery demos, live music and family activities including circus skills. Also Sunday 13 Sep.
datedPicks.whyPicked: Free, distinctive, locally rooted weekend festival with explicit family activities — the standout look-ahead for Sat–Sun.
datedPicks.parentHeadsUp: No advance ticket needed for entry. Busiest 10:00–14:00; quieter later. Parking £7. Runs both Sat and Sun.

datedPicks.title: Cardiff Brick Festival
datedPicks.location: National Indoor Athletics Centre, Cyncoed Campus, 9 Cyncoed Rd, Cardiff CF23 6XD
datedPicks.cost: Adult £8 · child 5–12 £6 · family £20 · under-5 free with paying adult · Early Bird £13
datedPicks.description: LEGO fan day: large displays, building area, speed builds, traders with loose bricks and sets. Book ahead — regularly sells out.
datedPicks.whyPicked: Clear family LEGO day with official ticket path — strong paid indoor option alongside the free Food Festival.
datedPicks.parentHeadsUp: Under-5s free with paying adult (no ticket). Book on organiser site; Early Bird includes gift + 10:00 entry.

datedPicks.title: St Fagans Food Festival (Sunday)
datedPicks.location: St Fagans National Museum of History, Cardiff CF5 6XB
datedPicks.cost: Free entry · parking £7 · some activities paid
datedPicks.description: Second day of the free St Fagans Food Festival — stalls, demos, music and family activities across the museum site.
datedPicks.whyPicked: Same free festival on Sunday — keeps the weekend window honest for parents choosing either day.
datedPicks.parentHeadsUp: Same notes as Saturday. Techniquest also runs a Relaxed Session Sun morning 10:00–12:00 if you want a quieter Bay option.

evergreen.title: St Fagans National Museum of History
evergreen.description: Historic buildings and open meadows west of the city. Food Festival takes over Sat–Sun 12–13 Sep — see dated picks.

evergreen.title: National Museum Cardiff
evergreen.description: Art, natural history and science galleries. Closed today (Monday). Under-16s with an adult; free day tickets recommended.

evergreen.title: Lisvane & Llanishen Reservoirs
evergreen.cost: Free to walk · paid water activities
evergreen.description: Circular paths, woodland trails, visitor-centre café and optional watersports. Good outdoor option when showers ease.

evergreen.title: Bute Park
evergreen.description: Central parkland beside Cardiff Castle — paths and play space without booking. NoFit Carnation Big Top is nearby at Sophia Gardens through 20 Sep (not child-specific).
